enable_networking.description: Set to true to allow network access (e.g., for LDAP/LDAPS). If false, disables networking via PrivateNetwork=true.

environment_vars.description: List of environment variable key-value pairs to pass to the Directory Server process. Each item is a list/tuple of [key, value]. Example: [['NSPR_LOG_MODULE', 'all:5'], ['NSPR_LOG_FILE', '/var/log/dirsrv/slapd-{{ instance_name }}/nspr.log']].

instance_name.description: Name of the 389-ds instance (must match systemd service name: 389-ds@<instance>.service). Must be alphanumeric with hyphens only; no spaces or special characters.

network_namespace.description: Name of the network namespace to use if networking is enabled. Leave empty for default namespace.

service_group.description: System group for the Directory Server instance. Typically 'dirsrv'.

service_user.description: System user account under which the Directory Server instance runs. Typically 'dirsrv'.
